image_description: A close-up, cropped view of a silver metallic flip-top lighter. The image focuses on the hinge mechanism and the upper body of the device. A faint, reversed inscription is visible on the lower part of the casing. The background is plain white.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is a macro crop showing only a portion of the object; there are no reference objects (like a hand) to verify scale.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object clearly exhibits a rectangular prism shape with a distinct horizontal seam indicating a hinged lid structure typical of Zippo-style lighters.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The nozzle is located at the top interior, which is outside the visible frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Hinged flip-top lid or fixed top with spark wheel.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The brass-colored hinge assembly is clearly visible and structurally coherent, connecting the lid to the body.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The surface shows realistic metallic reflections and a brushed texture consistent with chrome or steel.

The visual features (hinge, metal casing, size implication) strongly identify it as a portable lighter.

artifact_observations.location: Lower central body of the lighter
artifact_observations.reasoning: There is faint text engraved on the surface that appears mirrored/reversed and illegible. While some real lighters have engravings, AI models often struggle with rendering coherent text, resulting in 'alien' script or reversed characters. This is a noticeable anomaly.

The hinge geometry is slightly soft and lacks the sharp mechanical precision expected of stamped metal parts. The connection point between the hinge leaf and the body looks slightly fused rather than mechanically pinned.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a lighter and not a generic metal box or case.
To analyze the illegible/reversed text artifact and determine if it is nonsensical gibberish typical of AI generation.
To verify the structural connectivity of the hinge and ensure the lid and body are topologically distinct yet connected parts.

focus_areas: Legibility and orientation of the engraved text
Mechanical plausibility of the hinge assembly
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text artifact. If the text is confirmed as gibberish or reversed, this is a strong indicator of AI generation. Also, evaluate if the hinge geometry is physically possible or if it shows signs of 'melting' into the body.
